title: Round
description: One round within a map. CONFIRMED fields map to VCT Reference `rounds` (outcome + a start-of-round economy snapshot). Per-event timeline and per-player positions within the round are FUTURE (obtainable from vlr.gg 2D-replay logs via the method in vctstats ReplayPageParser; see event.schema.json / position.schema.json).

attackingTeamIdx.description: Which team was attacking this round. DERIVED: rounds.side describes team0's side, so attackingTeamIdx = 0 if side=='attack' else 1.

team0Side.description: The side team0 played this round. rounds.side.

startEconomy.description: Start-of-round economy snapshot. CONFIRMED from VCT Reference rounds (present on ~82% of rounds; null where economy_available is false). Values are credits.

loadoutValue.description: [team0, team1] total loadout value in credits. rounds.loadout_t0/t1.

bank.description: [team0, team1] remaining team bank in credits. rounds.bank_t0/t1.

plantSite.description: Spike plant site if planted. FUTURE: from replay logs; not in VCT Reference rounds table.

events.description: Ordered in-round events (event.schema.json). FUTURE for real data (requires 2D-replay logs); POPULATED for synthetic rounds.

items.description: eventId reference; full objects in events.json.
